title: 第7章 路遇绿茶女，首个专属打脸任务！
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

江辰一行人来到了中山路的美食街。

左右被两个颜值出众的精神小妹搂着，江辰毫无意外地，再次成为人群聚焦的重点。

“这哥们，有点实力啊！这左拥右抱的，还是两个极品小妹！”

“啧啧，那身材……换做是我，三天三夜都不想下床！”

“你们看，那小子面色虚成那样，还顶着个熊猫眼，怕是撑不了多久咯！”

江辰：“……”

对于人群投来的异样目光，丸子二人似乎早已见怪不怪。

毕竟精神小妹嘛，到哪都有人行注目礼。

“你们待会儿想吃点什么？”江辰询问两位小妹的意见。

丸子思考了几秒钟，提议道：“要不，我们去吃麻辣烫吧？”

闻言，香菜点了点头，赞同地道：“我赞成！也是好久没得吃了麻辣烫，正好回味一下。”

而后，目光看向江辰，“哥，你觉得怎么样？”

江辰微微颔首，“好，那就去吃麻辣烫。”

在吃饭这件事，江辰没什么讲究的，主打不挑食，能吃饱就行。

最关键的，还是财神爷吃好喝好，开心就行。

不远处，一家名为‘双喜麻辣烫’的餐饮店，赫然映入三人视线之中。

今天客人似乎要比往常要多一些。

就在这时！

一声响亮而有些尖锐的吼叫，响彻了整个四周。

“苏子文，你丫是来搞笑的吧！”

“本小姐为了跟你吃饭，可是精心打扮了几个小时，化了最美的妆容出门。”

“可结果呢，你就带我来这吃麻辣烫？”

“你到底是几个意思啊？”

面对女友扯着一口冲天炮似的嗓子，在耳边大喊大叫，苏子文傻眼了。

他很不理解，皱眉问道：“麻辣烫怎么了？我觉得，挺好吃的啊，以前在学校不是经常一起去吃吗？

再说了，只要能和喜欢的人在一起吃饭，具体吃什么有必要那么讲究吗？”

女友一听这话，顿时气不打一处来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Jiang Chen and his group arrived at the food court on Zhongshan Road.

Being hugged by two energetic young girls with outstanding looks, Jiang Chen, without any surprise, once again became the focus of the crowd's attention.

"This guy has some strength! Those hugging each other are two top-notch girls!"

"Tsk, that figure... if it were me, I wouldn't want to get out of bed for three days and three nights!"

"Look, that kid's face is so pale and he has panda eyes. I'm afraid he won't last long!"

Jiang Chen: "..."

The two of them seemed to be accustomed to the strange looks from the crowd.

After all, she is a spirited girl. People pay attention to her wherever she goes.

"What do you want to eat later?" Jiang Chen asked the two young ladies for their opinions.

Wanzi thought for a few seconds and suggested, "How about we go eat Malatang?"

Hearing this, Xiangcai nodded and said in agreement: "I agree! It's been a long time since I've had Malatang, so it's just a good time to have some aftertaste."

Then, he looked at Jiang Chen, "Brother, what do you think?"

Jiang Chen nodded slightly, "Okay, let's go eat Malatang."

When it comes to eating, Jiang Chen is not particular about food. He mainly focuses on not being picky about food, as long as he can eat enough.

The most important thing is that the God of Wealth eats well, drinks well, and is happy.

Not far away, a restaurant called 'Double Happiness Malatang' suddenly came into view of the three of them.

There seem to be more customers than usual today.

Right now!

A loud and somewhat sharp roar resounded throughout the surrounding area.

"Su Ziwen, you are just here to make fun of me!"

"In order to have dinner with you, I dressed up carefully for several hours and went out with the most beautiful makeup."

"But what happens, you just bring me here to eat spicy hotpot?"

"What do you mean?"

Su Ziwen was dumbfounded when his girlfriend shouted in his ears with a voice as loud as a cannon.

He didn't understand very much, frowned and asked: "What's wrong with Malatang? I think it's quite delicious. Didn't we often eat together in school?

Besides, as long as you can eat with the people you like, do you need to be so particular about what you eat?"

When my girlfriend heard this, she suddenly became furious.
